Name: Junimo Bundles Plus
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/CFHGZVY.png[/img]
[url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mqL6Uu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://smapi.io/][img]https://i.imgur.com/z1YXh1a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][img]https://i.imgur.com/pu4KdGu.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/KqHkrSg.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/d16FFpC.png[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4522][img]https://i.imgur.com/KPRFgYP.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNhm40R.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Q0tj0B7.png[/img][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[left][size=4]Every new farm, the Junimos write fresh bundle notes. You pick how:[/size]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]Junimo Remix[/color][/b]: they draw a [b]randomised[/b] set from everything the valley can grow, catch, forage and craft, modded items included. Every bundle is checked against real obtainability first (region unlocks, how high a quality that item can actually reach) before it's pinned to the bundles.[/size]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]Vanilla Plus[/color][/b]: they keep the bundles you know, the game's Normal or Remixed set, and content packs change them or add their own.[/size]

[size=4]Either way, the set is baked into your save the moment it's created and stays for good, so a different save gets a different one.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3e7CGG1.gif[/img]
[size=2][i]Every bundle drawn fresh for your farm.[/i][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVLxM2L.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][i][b][color=#e69138]Junimo Remix[/color][/b]
- [b]5 difficulty tiers[/b], Easy - Normal - Hard - Challenging - Impossible.
- [b]Balanced[/b] or [b]Chaos[/b] remix mode: Balanced keeps the familiar structure, where each bundle stays in its room. Chaos is even more randomised, so bundles can land in any room.
- [b]Bundle icons use 9 colours[/b] per room now instead of vanilla's 7, auto-assigned so nothing in the same room ever duplicates.
- Higher difficulties (on Challenging and up by default) can lock a bundle onto one specific artisan flavour (Apricot Jelly, say, not just any Jelly) instead of any variant of the item.
- [b]Remix Rewards[/b] (off by default): rewards can be drawn from a bundle's whole eligible reward pool instead of always vanilla's fixed pick, with rarer rewards coming up less often and per-entry difficulty gating.
- [b]Extra Reward Draws[/b] (off by default, on top of Remix Rewards): bundles also give extra items, like a fishing treasure chest, guaranteed on Hard and up by every preset, with no reward item repeating across the whole generated set. Pick a preset (Treasure Chest, Fixed, Generous) or tune your own.
- [b]Abandoned Joja Mart reward and extra bundles[/b]: give the Missing Bundle a real item reward instead of vanilla's no-reward bundle, and optionally let that room have more bundles (if any are added by content packs).

[b][color=#e69138]Vanilla Plus[/color][/b]
- [b]The game's own bundles[/b], Normal or Remixed, with content packs' changes and additions merged in item by item, alongside other bundle mods' edits.
- [b]No unreachable qualities[/b]: a bundle asking for a quality its item can't reach (an iridium Clam, say) is lowered to the best that item can reach, whichever mod wrote it.

[b][color=#e69138]Both[/color][/b]
- [b]7th Kitchen room[/b]: with Junimo Remix it gets its own drawn bundles; with Vanilla Plus, the original bundles from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9851][color=#e69138]Community Kitchen[/color][/url] and a room completion reward (also from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9851]Community Kitchen[/url]).
[/i][/size]
[spoiler][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/zLDolii.gif[/img]
[/i][/size]
[center][size=4][i]Finish the Kitchen and Gus delivers your order to the mailbox minutes after you call.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Fully content-pack extensible[/b]: anyone can add their own bundles/rewards/item rules from their own mod folder, no coding needed, just json content packs.
- [b]Fixes a vanilla bug[/b]: right-click-taking only part of a reward stack used to silently mark the whole reward as claimed and discard the rest — now the remainder stays owed until you actually take the whole (covers vanilla's own primary reward claim too, not just this mod's).[/i][/size][/left]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][color=#e69138]SK's Core Engine[/color][/url] (required).
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] (Optional) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] for the in-game settings menu.
[b][color=#e69138]4.[/color][/b] Download this mod and drop it in your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder.
[b][color=#e69138]5.[/color][/b] Pick [color=#f4f4f4]Bundles[/color] in the mod's settings: [b]Junimo Remix[/b] (default) or [b]Vanilla Plus[/b].
[b][color=#e69138]6.[/color][/b] Start a New Game. With Junimo Remix, leave [color=#f4f4f4]"Community Center Bundles"[/color] in the Advanced Options set to [b]Normal[/b] rather than [color=#f4f4f4][b]Remixed[/b][/color]. With Vanilla Plus, either is fine.
[b][color=#e69138]7.[/color][/b] Play! Your Community Centre is set the moment your save is created, and it never changes after that.[/size][/center]
[center][quote][i][b]Changed another mod's settings?[/b] Restart the game before starting a New Game, since some mods only apply setting changes after a restart and your bundles are built from whatever is active at that moment. In multiplayer, every player needs the same mods and mod settings as the host. (Tested only on local Co-op)[/i][/quote][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lcVaJJj.png[/img]
[left][size=4]Open the in-game [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] menu (if installed), or edit [color=#f4f4f4]config.json[/color] by hand.

The main things worth knowing about:

- [b][color=#f4f4f4]Bundles[/color][/b]: Junimo Remix (default; the settings below apply) or Vanilla Plus (the game's own bundles with content packs' changes; only the Kitchen room below applies)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]Mode[/color][/b]: Balanced (each room's bundles stay themed to that room) or Chaos (bundle definitions pool across every room, much less predictable)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]Difficulty[/color][/b]: Easy / Normal / Hard / Challenging / Impossible
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]RoomFill[/color][/b]: how many bundle slots each room fills (Vanilla / More / Max)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]EnableKitchenRoom[/color][/b]: adds the optional 7th Kitchen room (both styles)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]AllowMoneyBundlesOutsideVault[/color][/b]: off keeps gold-only bundles to the Vault room, instead of letting Chaos mode pool them into any room. On allows gold-only bundles in any room, including ones added by content packs.
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]EnableFlavorLockedIngredients[/color][/b]: off stops higher difficulties from locking a bundle onto one specific flavour (Apricot Jelly, not any Jelly)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]EnableAbandonedJojaMartReward[/color][/b]: gives the Missing Bundle a reward (vanilla's has none)
- [b][color=#f4f4f4]EnableAbandonedJojaMartExtraBundles[/color][/b]: lets the Abandoned Joja Mart have more than one bundle, if more are added by content packs; also turns the reward on
- Dozens more per-difficulty numeric knobs live in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url]'s advanced pages, for anyone who wants to hand-tune the balance further[/size]
[quote][i]Want to add your own bundles? This mod doubles as a content-pack framework: write a bundles.json in your own mod folder, no coding needed, and it merges straight into the pool alongside this mod's own bundle definitions. A pack can also override the built-in bundles and reward pools, changing only the fields it sets. Full authoring guides: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4522]Content Pack Authoring: Junimo Remix[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4523]Content Pack Authoring: Vanilla Plus[/url] for changing and adding the game's own bundles players get with Vanilla Plus (Normal and Remixed).[/i][/quote][/left]
[left][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qjQ1i2S.png[/img]
[center]Bundle candidates are pulled from real game data (context tags, categories) rather than a hardcoded item list. Items from a curated list of supported mods are picked up automatically, with no compatibility patches needed on either side.
Around 90 mods are supported, among them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][color=#e69138]Ridgeside Village[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][color=#e69138]East Scarp Remastered[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111][color=#e69138]Sunberry Village[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods][color=#e69138]Cornucopia[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods][color=#e69138]Mizu's animals[/color][/url]. Full list: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4521][color=#e69138]Added Mods[/color][/url]

[b][color=#e69138]Auto-Detected Compat Patches[/color][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21286][color=#e69138]Informant[/color][/url]: bundle colours, the Kitchen, exact flavours.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541][color=#e69138]Lookup Anything[/color][/url]: exact flavours in "needed for" and ingredient lookups.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43127][color=#e69138]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative[/color][/url]: exact flavours in the bundle banner.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45150][color=#e69138]Perfection Handbook[/color][/url]: the Kitchen's name, exact flavours.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9786][color=#e69138]Stardew Progress[/color][/url]: exact flavours.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4][color=#e69138]CJB Cheats Menu[/color][/url]: a Kitchen checkbox.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790][color=#e69138]Earthy Interiors[/color][/url]: matching Kitchen plaque art.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50688][color=#e69138]Mod Name Tooltip[/color][/url]: the Source Mod Lines setting.

[b][color=#e69138]Known Incompatibilities[/color][/b]
- With Junimo Remix, not compatible with other mods that fully rewrite Data/Bundles. With Vanilla Plus, their bundles are kept (e.g. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426][color=#e69138]SV Balance Overhaul[/color][/url]'s).
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27038][color=#e69138]Vegas' Better Item Categories[/color][/url] recategorises core vanilla items, which can conflict with vanilla's own data conventions — not something specific to this mod.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24254][color=#e69138]Geode Crusher Plus[/color][/url] strips the [font=monospace][color=#f4f4f4][i]geode_crusher_ignored[/i][/color][/font] tag from items that aren't actually geodes, losing the signal this mod relies on to keep them out of geode-only bundle slots.[/center]
[center][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gTMtgGy.png[/img]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] is the obvious one, for the in-game settings menu. Beyond that, big content mods pair especially well: this mod draws its item pool from supported installed mods, so more supported content mods means more bundle variety, not less compatibility. These all add real, correctly-tagged items this mod picks up automatically:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][color=#e69138]Ridgeside Village[/color][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][color=#e69138]East Scarp Remastered[/color][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods][color=#e69138]Cornucopia Mods[/color][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods][color=#e69138]Mizu's animal mods[/color][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830][color=#e69138]Love of Cooking[/color][/url][/center]
[center][left][quote]Using a mod that isn't on the list? Ask for it in the comments or bug reports. If its items can be gated sensibly (the game makes clear when and where each one becomes obtainable), support can ship in a future update.[/quote][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Lfacsh.png[/img]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55152][b][color=#e69138]SK's Core Editor[/color][/b][/url] is a separate, optional mod with its own page: an in-game tool for hand-tuning or writing your own bundle definitions, reward pools, or item rules without touching JSON, right inside the game.
[/left]
[/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PoPsPXp.png[/img]
[center][size=4]Text is in English for now, and translations from native speakers are welcome. The mod's [color=#f4f4f4]i18n[/color] folder already has a file for every language the game supports ([color=#f4f4f4]de, es, fr, hu, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh[/color]), filled with the English text. Translate the lines in your language's file and send it in a post or private message here: I'll add it in the next update and credit you. Bundle and room names the game translates itself already show in your language.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][i]- No translations yet: every language is open.[/i][/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXg7DRQ.png[/img]
[left][b]Will this affect my current save?[/b]
No. Bundles are generated once, when a save is created. Installing this mod never touches an existing save's Community Centre.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
In theory, yes, the host generates the bundle set once and it syncs to every farmhand automatically, same as vanilla's own world state. [i](Tested only on local Co-op)[/i]

[b]Is it safe to uninstall?[/b]
Mostly, with a few caveats. The actual donation requirements are baked permanently into your save the moment it's created, so those are never lost even if you remove the mod later. But a few things ARE rendered live by the mod every session rather than baked in, and will break specifically if you uninstall:
- Bundle names fall back to their raw internal id instead of a real name from content packs.
- A money bundle placed outside the Vault (if that option was on) stops working and makes the Community Centre uncompletable.
- Flavour-locked bundles lose their specific-flavour enforcement.
- The 2 new bundle icon colours (Pink/White) likely won't render right.
- The optional Kitchen room (if enabled) depends on the mod being present to function at all.
If you're just using the core 6-room Junimo Remix bundles with default settings, uninstalling is fully safe.

[b]Can I reroll my bundles mid-save?[/b]
No, they're locked in at save creation on purpose. That's also what makes them save-safe. Start a new save for a different set.

[b]Does this conflict with vanilla's own bundle Remixed settings?[/b]
With Junimo Remix, yes: with "Community Center Bundles" set to Remixed the mod logs a warning, so set it to Normal in the New Game advanced options first (see Installation above). With Vanilla Plus it's the opposite: Remixed works as in the base game, and content packs can change or add Remixed bundles too.[/left]
